snippet.title: Ocean Survivors - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Ocean Survivors on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225320?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=organic&utm_term=Trailer2Description

A pirate-themed, minimalistic, survivors-like where you dodge cannonballs, sink enemy ships, expand your arsenal, and loot their wrecks to climb the ranks. Upgrade your ship and become the ultimate pirate!

Ocean Survivors is a pirate-themed, score-attack game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements. Fight off hordes of enemies and level up your ship. How far can you climb the ranks?

Sink enemy ships and pick up XP to level up! The more you level up, the bigger your advantage against enemies is.

It's a new game every time, where your upgrades don't carry over. What distinguishes you from others is a combination of luck and skill. Do you have what it takes?

Gold from sunken ships is for you to grab. Climb the scoreboard and claim the #1 spot to become the ultimate pirate!

#indiegame
